At the start of the reaction, the concentration of $R$, $[R]_0$, is 10-times the concentration of $A$, $[A]_0$. [$k$ and $k'$ represent corresponding rate constants]

Use: Universal gas constant (R) $= 8.3\,\mathrm{J\,K^{-1}\,mol^{-1}}$ and acceleration due to gravity ($g$) $= 10\,\mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$
